reason: The current single multiway external join has produced more than 20 TB of cumulative spill I/O. BioMiner needs partition- or part-bound resumability with strict row-preservation and one-to-one join gates. GitHits supported the architecture but both generated examples contained correctness defects, so only the high-level patterns are retained and the executable design must be proven by local tests.
